card.name: O in capitalized EMBRYO-FETAL
card.fires_on: The letter O at the end of the capitalized word EMBRY(O) in boxed-warning titles such as EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY. Also fires on the same spot in EMBRYOLOGY, and once on a capitalized word ending in WATERSHEDS.

modes.label: Boxed warning EMBRYO-FETAL
modes.description: The O completing EMBRYO before a hyphen and FETAL in all-caps boxed warning headings.

modes.label: Other all-caps words
modes.description: The same ending in other all-caps words, such as a list of science fields or a title.
modes.example: , including the fields of ALLERGOLOGY, ANATOMY, BACTERIOLOGY, BOTANY, DENTISTRY, EMBRY<<O>>LOGY, ENVIRONMENTALISM, ET

card.plain: It fires on the last letters of the all-caps word EMBRYO in boxed warning headings about embryo-fetal toxicity.
